rationale: Navigation fix after the snapshot-repair measurement: the parent configuration question's discriminator asked whether an installed snapshot restores the recovered configuration, and that is now answered in the account with the two repair receipts. The discriminator is replaced with what the account still leaves open — store variants, since every measurement used the repository's in-memory commit-tracking store, and whether a monotonic store or a differently configured snapshot cadence changes either the gap or its repair. No evidence, comparison or conclusion changes.

investigations.discriminator: Whether the gap and the consequences measured under it also appear with other log store shapes, in particular a commit-tracking store that is also monotonic and one whose snapshot cadence never leaves a committed configuration entry between the last snapshot and the recovered commit index; both repair paths are now measured, so the remaining question is the breadth of the store and snapshot-cadence assumptions rather than the mechanism.
